instruction: Set the background color of the month header cells (B2 through F2) to blue (#0000ff) in the calendar spreadsheet.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to highlight all weekend dates across 5 months but failed. It correctly identified June 4-5 as Saturday-Sunday and selected B6:B7, applied partial red background. Then tried using Name Box with comma-separated multi-range but got a syntax error. Only managed to partially color a few cells.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Calc, navigate cells, select cell ranges, apply background colors via highlighting button, use Name Box for cell selection
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because: (1) incorrectly mapped date-to-row for months other than June, (2) used commas instead of semicolons for Name Box multi-range selection, (3) ran out of turns after error recovery attempts.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a contiguous range formatting task (B2:F2, 5 cells in a row). Avoids the complex multi-range selection that caused the original failure. Tests basic cell background coloring on a simple, contiguous selection.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting blue background on 5 contiguous header cells B2:F2 (Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct). This is a simple contiguous range selection + color application. Getter reads fill colors of B2:F2. Metric checks each cell for 0000FF with partial credit (0.2 per cell).

scoring_breakdown.each_cell: 0.2 per correctly colored cell (5 cells total)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts background fill colors for all 5 specified cells (B2-F2) using openpyxl, handling both fgColor.rgb and solid pattern start_color.rgb
Metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (proper handling of expected.type='rule') and accesses expected_color and cells without wrapping errors
Substring color comparison ('0000FF' in actual.upper()) correctly handles openpyxl's alpha-prefixed 8-char RGB format (e.g., 'FF0000FF')
Complete coverage: all 5 cells in the instruction (B2, C2, D2, E2, F2) are checked with appropriate partial credit scoring (0.2 per cell)
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state
